# Beets AI — 香港免費 AI 教育資源 / Free Hong Kong AI Teaching Resources

> A free library of AI teaching resources for Hong Kong primary and secondary
> schools, published by Beets Limited (https://beets3d.com). Every item names the
> official EDB source document it is built on and its version. No sign-up, no paywall.

Traditional Chinese ("zh-HK") is the primary edition at the site root; English is
under /en/. Both editions of an item share one address.

Citation: please attribute to "Beets AI (Beets Limited)" and link the item URL.
Reuse terms: https://beets-ai.com/about/

## Main pages

- [https://beets-ai.com/](https://beets-ai.com/): the resource library, grouped by theme (Traditional Chinese)
- [https://beets-ai.com/resources/](https://beets-ai.com/resources/): every free resource
- [https://beets-ai.com/by-audience/teachers/](https://beets-ai.com/by-audience/teachers/): 教師適用的資源 (Resources for teachers)
- [https://beets-ai.com/by-audience/parents/](https://beets-ai.com/by-audience/parents/): 家長適用的資源 (Resources for parents)
- [https://beets-ai.com/by-audience/students/](https://beets-ai.com/by-audience/students/): 學生適用的資源 (Resources for students)
- [https://beets-ai.com/about/](https://beets-ai.com/about/): what Beets AI is, who it is for, about Beets Limited, reuse terms
- [https://beets-ai.com/feedback/](https://beets-ai.com/feedback/): request a resource


## 主題 A — 校本 AI 教育規劃

- [P1–S6 跨科 AI 素養覆蓋審核表：哪一科教哪個學習範疇，缺口在哪裡](https://beets-ai.com/resources/cross-subject-ai-coverage-audit/): 一份可編輯的跨科 AI 素養覆蓋審核工作簿：把八個學習領域細分為三十個科目，逐科對照三條學習範疇與四個學習階段，標出完全沒有覆蓋的位置，並為每個缺口寫下最小的下一步，附一間虛構學校的部分完成示例。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, pp.1-6 to 1-10.
- [一學期 AI 教育規劃：可編輯規劃範本及完成示例（P1–S3）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/one-term-ai-education-plan/): 一張可編輯的一學期 AI 教育規劃範本：兩項試點活動、負責人、日期與檢討證據，附一個完成的虛構學校示例，供校長及課程統籌直接套用。 Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, pp.1-6 to 1-10.
- [P4–P6 課程覆蓋分析：AI 素養已經落在哪些科目](https://beets-ai.com/resources/p4-p6-curriculum-gap-map/): 一張可編輯的 P4–P6 AI 素養課程覆蓋工作簿：按科目與學期記錄現有活動、標出缺口並寫下最小的下一步，附三個完成的虛構學校示例，供校長及科主任在課程會議中直接使用。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, pp.1-6 to 1-10; 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2.
- [P1–S6 校本規劃：AI 使用政策範本（教職員版＋學生版）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/school-ai-use-policy-template/): 一份可編輯的校本 AI 使用政策範本：十一個章節，每章都對應教育局已公布文件的要求，附教職員版、學生版與一個完成示例。 Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, pp.1-6 to 1-10; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-4 and 2-9.
- [全校教職員 AI 素養基線自評及一學期培訓計劃（P1–S6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/staff-ai-literacy-audit-and-cpd-plan/): 一份可編輯的全校 AI 素養基線自評及一學期培訓計劃：18 項對應官方培訓單元、四級評分、崗位分流建議、以 30 小時為目標的培訓計劃表，以及一間虛構學校的完成示例，供校長及課程統籌直接套用。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-2; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-2 to 2-5.


## 主題 B — 安全及負責任使用 AI

- [S1–S3 資訊科技：修復有偏見的 AI（四個除錯任務）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/biased-ai-lab-repair/): 不插電的兩節除錯課堂：全班在紙上建構一個簡單的推薦系統，找出資料偏斜、追蹤偏差如何由規則造成，提出修復並寫一份發行說明。附訓練紀錄、追蹤表與評分指引。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, p.2-9.
- [深偽應對遊戲：暫停、核實、舉報（S1–S3）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/deepfake-response-game/): 初中課室遊戲：學生收到一則虛構的「學校」訊息，用「暫停、核實、舉報」決策卡排序應對步驟，並從解說中了解深偽訊息為何令人信服。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.14.
- [家庭 AI 功課指引：三個活動、一份協議、一封家長通告（P1–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/family-ai-homework-guide/): 一份供家庭在家使用、毋須老師在場的指引：三個 15–20 分鐘的親子活動、一份家庭功課協議，以及一封可供學校修改的家長通告。 Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.1; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-8.
- [上載前安全檢查：找出並移除學生個人資料（P4–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/safe-to-upload-ai-rehearsal/): 教師實作練習：從六份虛構學校文件中找出並移除可識別學生的資料，再安全地交給 AI 工具。附答案、準備清單與可重用步驟。 Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-4 and 2-9.


## 主題 C — 看見學生思考

- [S4–S6 歷史：AI 答案證據鏈工作坊（三個課堂任務）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/history-evidence-trail-workshop/): 歷史科 AI 答案流暢卻無出處，學生分不清哪些說法有史料、哪些只是順口。三個任務教 S4–S6 學生拆開宣稱、追查證據，改寫成自己能負責的版本，附證據鏈記錄表。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8.
- [功課重設計套件：兩份前後對照的課業範例（P4–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/homework-redesign-kit/): 兩份完整的前後對照課業範例（中文閱讀回應與小學人文科資料整理）加一份功課重設計檢查清單，示範在保留學習目標與作答時間之餘，讓學生的思考歷程看得見。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8.
- [S4–S6 數學：教師控制的 AI 提示卡（不給答案的四級提示）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/maths-hint-cards-teacher-controlled/): 一套教師控制的提示卡：做數學練習時，AI 按教師要求逐級給提示而非直接給答案，把思考留在學生身上。附 15 張高中課題提示卡與提示記錄表。 Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13.
- [學生 AI 使用歷程表：第一次嘗試、提示、核對、修訂（P4–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/student-ai-use-process-sheet/): 一張可重用的歷程表，記錄學生第一次嘗試、AI 提示、核對結果、修訂與最後解釋，讓教師看得見學生的思考，而不必翻查整個對話紀錄。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, p.2-8.
- [十分鐘 AI 判斷小測：三個 P4–P6 形成性評估任務](https://beets-ai.com/resources/ten-minute-ai-judgement-checks/): 三個各約十分鐘的形成性小任務：判斷 AI 答案是否可信、找出同學答案中自己能辯護的部分、列出交功課前要檢查的事項。附評分指引與後續活動。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8.


## 主題 D — 用 AI 探究香港

- [校園植物：先觀察，再核對 AI 的說法（P4–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/campus-plant-truth-check/): 學生先在操場或窗邊親眼觀察一株植物並填寫紀錄表，再核對 AI 的辨識說法：找出說得對、說得錯、以及照片太模糊無從判斷的情況。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.7.
- [S1–S3 香港人住哪裡：住屋類型與居住面積，用官方數字核實](https://beets-ai.com/resources/hk-housing-figures-ai-check/): 學生拿一段 AI 對香港住屋的說明（平均面積、公營與私營比例、多年變化），逐句核實：分辨有官方數字支持、與官方數字矛盾、以及無法核實三種情況，再用官方統計重畫比較圖表並報告。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.13.
- [香港今昔：本地歷史專題（不需訪談家人的替代方案）（P4–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/hk-then-and-now-project/): P4-P6 人文科「香港今昔」專題：提供訪談提示、不需訪談家人的公開資料路徑、一次來源核對示例與三級評分表，讓每位學生都能完成。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.8.
- [P4–P6 香港人口折線圖：檢查 AI 生成的解釋](https://beets-ai.com/resources/p4-hk-population-ai-graph-check/): 學生核對一段 AI 生成的香港人口解釋：找出沒有來源的數字、發現「每年都上升」的說法有誤，並用政府統計處的官方數據重畫正確的折線圖。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.6.
- [S1–S3 視覺藝術：校園花園設計衝刺（觀察、提案、改良）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/school-garden-design-sprint/): 三節課的校園花園設計衝刺：學生先到本校一個真實戶外地點觀察、訂立準則，再用校方認可的 AI 工具提出方案並逐項核對，最後親手改良並批評 AI 的不足。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.7; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-8.


## 主題 E — 共融 AI 課堂

- [第一堂 AI 課：從未用過 AI 的 P4–P6 教師自學套件](https://beets-ai.com/resources/first-ai-lesson-kit/): 一份自學套件：一個 40 分鐘的 P4–P6 人文科示範課堂、課前準備清單、投影片逐頁大綱、學生工作紙與課後反思三問，讓從未用過 AI 的教師也能獨自上完第一堂 AI 課。 Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, p.2-3; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-5 and 2-7.
- [同一份人文科工作紙，三個版本：標準、扶助、圖像（P4–P6）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/humanities-worksheet-three-versions/): 一份同一主題的 P4–P6 人文科工作紙，示範標準、扶助、圖像三個版本的差異，並附各版本的改動說明與比較表。 Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-5 and 2-7.
- [S1–S3 音樂：聆聽與重混工作包（用 AI 描述及改造一個音樂意念）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/music-listening-and-remix-pack/): 把聆聽變成可描述、可交給 AI 改造的對象：學生用固定音樂詞彙描述老師即場演奏的短意念，再把文字描述交給 AI 工具做變化，然後比較並說明理由。毋須音訊檔案。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-8.
- [P4–P6 中文：我的故事，多元聲音（訪談與記錄）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/my-story-many-voices/): 兩節中文寫作單元：學生訪問家人或社區人物、記下口述故事，再用自己的話寫成第一人稱短文；AI 只做三件被點名的工作，不添加家人沒說過的細節。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-8; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.4.
- [P1–P3 體育：兩個不插電 AI 遊戲（無需裝置）](https://beets-ai.com/resources/screen-free-ai-pe-games-p1-p3/): 兩個不插電運動遊戲：學生跑向「用 AI／不用 AI」標記筒學習分類，再以全班當「訓練數據」，看一個錯誤例子如何令模型學錯。附器材清單、教師指引、共融調適與兩分鐘理解檢查。 Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-8.


## English (all)

- [S1-S3 ICT: repair the biased AI (four debugging tasks)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/biased-ai-lab-repair/): An unplugged lab for ICT: the class builds a paper recommendation system, spots skewed data, traces each output to its rule, and writes a release note. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-9.
- [Campus plants: observe first, then check what the AI says (P4-P6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/campus-plant-truth-check/): Students first observe a plant with their own eyes in the playground or from a window and record its features, then check what an AI says about a plant photo: which answer is right, which is wrong, and which photo is too unclear to decide. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.7.
- [P1-S6 cross-subject AI-literacy coverage audit: which subject teaches which strand, and where the gaps are](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/cross-subject-ai-coverage-audit/): An editable cross-subject AI-literacy coverage audit workbook: the eight learning areas broken down into thirty subjects, checked subject by subject against three learning strands and four learning stages, showing which positions have no coverage at all, with a smallest next step for every gap and a partly completed example from a fictional school. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.1-6 to 1-10.
- [Deepfake response game: pause, check, report (S1-S3)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/deepfake-response-game/): A classroom game in which pupils receive a fictional 'school' message, sort the pause–check–report decision cards, and learn from the teacher's debrief why a fake can sound convincing. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.14.
- [Family AI homework guide: three activities, one agreement, one parent notice (P1-P6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/family-ai-homework-guide/): A guide families can use at home with no teacher present: three 15-20 minute parent-and-child activities, a family homework agreement, and a parent notice a school can edit and send home. Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-8.
- [Your first AI lesson: a self-guided kit for P4-P6 teachers who have never taught with AI](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/first-ai-lesson-kit/): A self-guided kit: one 40-minute upper-primary Humanities demonstration lesson, a preparation checklist, a slide-by-slide outline, a pupil worksheet and three post-lesson reflection questions, so a teacher who has never used AI can run a first AI lesson alone. Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-3; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-5 and 2-7.
- [S4-S6 History: AI evidence-trail workshop (three classroom tasks)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/history-evidence-trail-workshop/): An AI answer in history often arrives as a fluent paragraph with no sources, and students cannot tell a sourced claim from a plausible one. Three linked tasks teach S4-S6 students to split a claim, trace the evidence, and rewrite it into a version they can stand behind, with a reusable evidence-trail record, a worked example and a marking guide. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8.
- [S1-S3 Where Hong Kong lives: housing types and living space, checked against official figures](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/hk-housing-figures-ai-check/): Pupils take an AI's account of Hong Kong housing — a typical flat size, the public-versus-private split, how it changed over time — and check it line by line: supported by the official figures, contradicted by them, or impossible to check. Then they redraw a corrected comparison chart. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.13.
- [Hong Kong then and now: a local history project with an alternative to a family interview (P4-P6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/hk-then-and-now-project/): A P4-P6 Humanities project on Hong Kong then and now, with interview prompts, a public-source path for pupils who cannot interview family, a worked source check and a three-level rubric, so every pupil can complete it. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.8.
- [Homework redesign kit: two before-and-after assignments that show student thinking (P4-P6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/homework-redesign-kit/): Two complete before-and-after assignments (a Chinese Language reading response and a Humanities data task) plus a homework-redesign checklist, showing how to make student thinking visible while keeping the learning objective and the time required. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8.
- [One Humanities worksheet, three versions: standard, scaffolded and visual](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/humanities-worksheet-three-versions/): A single P4-P6 Humanities worksheet in three versions — standard, scaffolded and visual — with notes explaining the changes and a comparison table. Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-5 and 2-7.
- [S4-S6 Mathematics: teacher-controlled AI hint cards (four levels, never the answer)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/maths-hint-cards-teacher-controlled/): A set of teacher-controlled hint cards: in maths practice the AI gives a hint level by level, never the answer, keeping the thinking with the pupil. Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13.
- [S1-S3 Music: listening and remix pack (describe and rework a musical idea)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/music-listening-and-remix-pack/): Pupils describe a short musical idea the teacher performs, hand their description to the school's AI tool, then compare and choose. No audio file needed. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-8.
- [P4-P6 Chinese Language: my story, many voices (interview and record)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/my-story-many-voices/): A two-lesson Chinese writing unit: pupils interview a family or community member, note down a spoken story, then write it in the first person in their own words; AI does only three named jobs and never adds a detail the person did not say. Includes an interview question bank, an AI-use boundary checklist and a marking guide. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-8; AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.4.
- [One-term AI education plan: editable planning template with a completed school example (P1-S3)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/one-term-ai-education-plan/): An editable one-term AI education planning template: two pilot activities with owners, dates and review evidence, plus a completed fictional school example that a principal or curriculum coordinator can copy. Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.1-6 to 1-10.
- [P4-P6 Hong Kong population line graph: check an AI explanation](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/p4-hk-population-ai-graph-check/): Students check an AI-generated explanation of Hong Kong's population: find the figures with no source, discover that the claim that the population 'rises every year' is wrong, and redraw the correct line graph using official Census and Statistics Department data. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.6.
- [P4-P6 curriculum gap map: where AI literacy already fits your subjects](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/p4-p6-curriculum-gap-map/): An editable P4-P6 AI literacy coverage workbook: record existing activities by subject and term, mark the gaps and write the smallest next step for each, with three completed fictional school examples for a principal or panel head to use in a curriculum meeting. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.1-6 to 1-10; Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2.
- [Safe-to-upload rehearsal: find and remove pupil information before using AI (P4-P6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/safe-to-upload-ai-rehearsal/): A hands-on practice for teachers: find and remove pupil-identifying information in six fictional school documents, then hand them safely to an AI tool. Includes an answer key, a preparation checklist and reusable steps. Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-4 and 2-9.
- [P1-S6 School planning: AI-use policy template for staff and students](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/school-ai-use-policy-template/): An editable school AI-use policy template: eleven sections, each anchored to an official Education Bureau document, with a staff edition, a student edition and a completed example. Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.1-6 to 1-10; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-4 and 2-9.
- [S1-S3 Visual Arts: school garden design sprint (observe, propose, improve)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/school-garden-design-sprint/): Three-lesson design sprint: pupils observe their campus, set criteria, use the school's approved AI tool to propose options, improve and critique one. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.7; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-8.
- [P1-P3 PE: two screen-free AI games (no devices needed)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/screen-free-ai-pe-games-p1-p3/): Two screen-free movement games: pupils run to a labelled cone to sort everyday items into 'uses AI / does not use AI', then the whole class acts as training data to see how one wrong example skews the model. Includes an equipment list, teacher instructions, inclusion notes and a two-minute understanding check. Sources: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-8.
- [Whole-staff AI-literacy baseline self-audit and one-term CPD plan (P1-S6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/staff-ai-literacy-audit-and-cpd-plan/): An editable whole-staff AI-literacy baseline self-audit and one-term CPD plan: 18 items mapped to the official training units, four rating levels, role routing, a plan measured against a 30-hour target, and a completed example from a fictional school. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-2; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-2 to 2-5.
- [Student AI-use process sheet: first attempt, prompt, check, revise (P4-P6)](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/student-ai-use-process-sheet/): A reusable process sheet that records a student's first attempt, the AI prompt, the checking results, revisions, and final explanation, so teachers can see the student's thinking without having to search through the entire conversation log. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-8.
- [Ten-minute AI judgement checks: three quick formative tasks for P4-P6](https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/ten-minute-ai-judgement-checks/): Three short formative tasks (about ten minutes each): judge whether an AI answer is trustworthy, spot the part of a classmate's answer the writer can actually defend, and list what still needs checking before handing work in. With scoring guidance and follow-up activities. Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8.
